references.text: Describes the preceding part of the northern border, from the Sea to Mount Hor and onward to Lebo-Hamath, leading to Ziphron and Hazar-Enan mentioned in verse 9.
Ezekiel describes Israel's future borders and mentions Hazar-Enan as the endpoint of the northern border, just as in this text.
Ezekiel mentions Hazar-Enan again in connection with the distribution of the land among the tribes, confirming the place's significance as a northern boundary marker.
Continues the description of the border from Hazar-Enan and proceeds to define the eastern border.
